title: Quality Trigger Efficiency Implementation Tasks
principles: Remove duplicate execution without weakening pull-request or main-branch coverage.
Keep the Quality graph read-only and unchanged beyond trigger admission.
Update the owning policy, documentation and proof context in the same slice.

globalVerification.commitPolicy: Commit only after the focused policy, documentation and repository checks pass and the no-Changeset decision is recorded.
evidenceRequired: Accepted workflow with pull_request and push: main only
Hosted pull-request Quality result for the candidate commit
Changed-owner impact ledger and explicit non-claims

nonClaims: No hosted deployment or provider state is established.

downstreamArtifactImpact.verification: bun run check:docs and bun run check:runbooks
No package contract or release artifact changes.
nonClaims: No package version or publication is implied.

tasks.title: Remove duplicate feature-branch push trigger
tasks.goal: Run one Quality graph for each pull request and one post-merge graph on main.
outputs: pull_request and push: main workflow triggers
policy rejection for any additional push branch
current trigger documentation and lifecycle proof
tasks.implementationPrompt: Keep the release graph, permissions, timeout, concurrency and browser bootstrap unchanged. Remove only the codex/** push trigger, update the Schema-backed policy and add a negative fixture. Preserve historical receipts.
qualityAudits: Review the trigger call graph for lost coverage or duplicate execution.
Review changed durable owners for contradictions and historical-evidence boundaries.
Review the final diff for unrelated workflow, package or provider changes.

parentAudit.basis: Review the workflow diff, policy fixture, documentation impact ledger and hosted Quality result.
parentAudit.recovery: Revert or correct the trigger contract if coverage, policy or proof does not match this SPEC.

completionCriteria: The candidate pull-request Quality run passes.
The change is merged to main and the completed plan records the result.
